Diagnose a Distance Matrix

Source: R/matching_messages.R
diagnose_distance_matrix.Rd

Comprehensive diagnostics for a distance matrix with actionable suggestions.

Usage

diagnose_distance_matrix(
  cost_matrix,
  left = NULL,
  right = NULL,
  vars = NULL,
  warn = TRUE
)

# S3 method for class 'distance_diagnostics'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'distance_diagnostics'
summary(object, ...)

Arguments

cost_matrix

Numeric matrix of distances

left

Left dataset (for variable checking)

right

Right dataset (for variable checking)

vars

Variables used for matching

warn

If TRUE, issue warnings

x, object

A distance_diagnostics object.

...

Ignored.

Value

A distance_diagnostics list with the cost distribution, variable issues, problem variables, suggestions, and quality assessment. summary() returns these findings as summary.distance_diagnostics.
